scope: Client onboarding answers respect all blockers and cancellation, release stale execution ownership, and reach bounded persisted execution context.

assertions: Canonical two-client-answer lifecycle: first answer and replay preserve AWAITING_INPUT and old ownership; claim remains denied.
Final client blocker releases populated bridge, worker, lease token, lease expiry and heartbeat, queues exact run; exact replay is eligible only while still QUEUED.
Replay validates exact authorized client message; wrong actor first/replay denied and wrong venue cannot locate link.
Concurrent direct founder/client answers serialize with one eligible result, zero pending blockers and a QUEUED run.
Cancelled run accepts and retains linked late response as answered, remains CANCELLED, replay ineligible.
Real subsequent claim receives each exact client response with support IDs, author, body and timestamp; unrelated same-run ANSWER excluded.
No approval request or agent action created; one client-answer audit per exact claim.
limitations: Synthetic tenant/user/credential/bridge/worker foreign-key setup only uses middleware bypass. Disabled credential metadata is intentionally non-authenticating; no real credential or provider accessed.
Canonical helpers and explicit scoped readbacks execute with normal middleware. This is not an auth-provider, connected-browser, queue-delivery or live-worker inference proof.
One real concurrent direct/client answer pair, not an exhaustive interleaving/stress proof.
